description: Header file defining classes and interfaces for EGL objects in Android, including egl_object_t, egl_surface_t, and egl_context_t, with reference counting and resource management.

classes.name: egl_object_t
classes.description: Base class for EGL objects with reference counting and resource management.

classes.name: egl_surface_t
classes.description: Represents an EGL surface, manages native window and metadata.

classes.name: egl_context_t
classes.description: Represents an EGL context, manages OpenGL extensions and state.
